lines.zh: 我背上的黑壳比石头还沉。
lines.en: The black shell on my back is heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 走一步，留下一条亮亮的水痕。
lines.en: Each step leaves a bright wet trail behind me.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石太滑，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The river cobbles are slick, so I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着一块石头爬了半个早晨。
lines.en: I have climbed one stone for half a morning.

lines.zh: 黑帽压得低，我几乎看不见路。
lines.en: My black cap sits low; I can barely see the way.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面，我们隔得很远。
lines.en: My companion is ahead, a long way ahead.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就把身体压低些。
lines.en: The current pushes; I press my body lower.

lines.zh: 黏液干了会发亮，像一条银线。
lines.en: Dried slime shines like a silver thread.

lines.zh: 我绕开水草，那东西会缠人。
lines.en: I go around the weeds; they tangle.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸出去，先探探深浅。
lines.en: I stretch my tentacles out to test the depth.

lines.zh: 两小时过去了，我挪了一臂远。
lines.en: Two hours gone and I have moved one arm's length.

lines.zh: 河岸的泥软，走起来省力。
lines.en: The bank mud is soft, which makes walking easier.

lines.zh: 壳底磕在石上，咚的一声。
lines.en: My shell knocks a stone with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我跟在它后面，走同一条痕。
lines.en: I follow behind it along the very same trail.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，往前挪半寸。
lines.en: I lift and creep forward half an inch.

lines.zh: 河底的光斜了，我换个方向。
lines.en: The light slants. I change direction.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩进壳，只留眼睛在外。
lines.en: I draw into my shell with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 河水从我壳顶漫过去，很凉。
lines.en: River water washes over my shell, quite cold.

lines.zh: 我在等一片叶子漂到我面前。
lines.en: I wait for a leaf to drift up to my face.

lines.zh: 黑帽上积了一点沙，我抖不掉。
lines.en: Sand gathers on my black cap and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 河里有鱼影掠过，我不理。
lines.en: Fish shadows sweep past and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 这一块石头上长着最好的藻。
lines.en: The best algae in the river grows on this stone.

lines.zh: 同伴贴着我，一动也不动。
lines.en: My companion presses against me, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我的黏液把沙子粘成一团。
lines.en: My slime glues grains of sand into a clump.

lines.zh: 天光透过水，落成一块块圆斑。
lines.en: Daylight through the water lands in round patches.

lines.zh: 我嚼了一上午，还没嚼完。
lines.en: I have chewed all morning and am not finished.

lines.zh: 壳里闷得像蒸笼，可我不出去。
lines.en: It is muggy as an oven in here, but I stay.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步，没有抬头。
lines.en: I hear footsteps on the bank and do not look up.

lines.zh: 谁把这块石头翻过来了？真亮。
lines.en: Who turned this stone over? It is so bright.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，一分钟三次。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, three times a minute.

lines.zh: 有只小虾从我壳边爬过去。
lines.en: A little shrimp crawls past my shell.

lines.zh: 我把眼柄转向水面，等风。
lines.en: I turn my eyestalks to the surface and wait.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，影子盖住了我的河。
lines.en: You bend down and your shadow covers my river.

lines.zh: 我从壳里伸出眼睛看你。
lines.en: I push my eyes out of the shell to look at you.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我得把触角抬起来。
lines.en: You are so tall I must raise my tentacles.

lines.zh: 你的靴子边沾着河泥。
lines.en: River mud clings to the edge of your boots.

lines.zh: 你要把我捡起来吗？我有点重。
lines.en: Will you pick me up? I am rather heavy.

lines.zh: 我停在原处，等你先动。
lines.en: I stay put and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你看我的黑帽，我缩了半寸。
lines.en: You look at my black cap and I shrink half an inch.

lines.zh: 水里的倒影比你还大。
lines.en: Your reflection in the water is larger than you.

lines.zh: 我只是慢慢挪了一下，别急。
lines.en: I only shifted slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 你在数我的纹路吗？数不清的。
lines.en: Are you counting my whorls? There are too many.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的菜叶味道。
lines.en: I know the smell of the greens in your hand.

lines.zh: 我抬头，你就成了整片天。
lines.en: I look up and you become the whole sky.

lines.zh: 壳被敲了一下，我整个人一缩。
lines.en: My shell is struck and I pull in entirely.

lines.zh: 疼从壳口传进来，闷闷的。
lines.en: Pain seeps in through the shell opening, muffled.

lines.zh: 我掉了半寸，滚进石缝。
lines.en: I drop half an inch and roll into a crack.

lines.zh: 谁在砸我？这壳很硬的。
lines.en: Who is pounding me? This shell is hard.

lines.zh: 黏液一下子涌出来，糊住了口。
lines.en: Slime floods out and seals my opening.

lines.zh: 我的触角缩回去了，看不见了。
lines.en: My tentacles retract and I can no longer see.

lines.zh: 我的壳多了一条磨不掉的白线。
lines.en: My shell has a new white line that will not rub off.

lines.zh: 我不动，等它以为我死了。
lines.en: I stay still and let it think I am dead.

lines.zh: 这一下让我偏离了石头。
lines.en: That blow knocked me off my stone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬，疼也跟着慢慢来。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, and the pain arrives as slowly.

lines.zh: 那是菜叶吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Are those greens? I can smell them.

lines.zh: 我的触角全伸出来了，收不住。
lines.en: All my tentacles are out and will not retract.

lines.zh: 一片叶子，够我吃上一整天。
lines.en: One leaf would feed me for a whole day.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪，慢得让人着急。
lines.en: I creep toward you, maddeningly slowly.

lines.zh: 河里的藻太苦，这个闻着甜。
lines.en: River algae taste bitter; this smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只眼，先看清再决定。
lines.en: I extend one eye to look before deciding.

lines.zh: 同伴也抬头了，我们都在看。
lines.en: My companion looks up too; we are both watching.

lines.zh: 你把它放低一点，我就够得到。
lines.en: Lower it a little and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我壳里都是口水，真是丢人。
lines.en: My shell is full of drool; how shameful.

lines.zh: 走得再快也没用，我就是慢。
lines.en: Rushing does nothing; slow is what I am.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了水的凉。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget how cold the water is.

lines.zh: 我咬住叶边，一点一点拖。
lines.en: I grip the leaf edge and drag it bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你要收回去？那我可要生气了。
lines.en: Taking it back? Then I shall be cross.

lines.zh: 我从来没见过这么绿的东西。
lines.en: I have never seen anything so green.

lines.zh: 你要给就快点，我等着。
lines.en: Hand it over soon. I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，壳都发紧了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet. My shell tightens.

lines.zh: 谁撞了我的壳？声音很闷。
lines.en: Who struck my shell? It made a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我被推得滑出去一段。
lines.en: I am shoved and slide a fair distance.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我缩进去了。
lines.en: You stepped on me, and I have withdrawn.

lines.zh: 同伴撞过来，我们卡在一起。
lines.en: My companion bumps me and we stick together.

lines.zh: 壳没有裂，只是响了一下。
lines.en: The shell is not cracked, only rang once.

lines.zh: 我滚了半圈，好不容易翻回来。
lines.en: I rolled half over and barely righted myself.

lines.zh: 那条鱼撞了我，跑了。
lines.en: That fish rammed me and fled.

lines.zh: 我的黏液替你做了个滑梯。
lines.en: My slime made you a slide.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，我本来就慢。
lines.en: A knock is fine; I am slow regardless.

lines.zh: 我停在石头后面，等世界不晃。
lines.en: I stop behind a stone and wait for the world to settle.

lines.zh: 我们两只，一前一后，慢慢靠。
lines.en: The two of us close the gap, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸过去，碰它的触角。
lines.en: I reach out and touch my tentacle to its own.

lines.zh: 它的黑帽比我的深一点。
lines.en: Its black cap is a shade deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 河湾的水草边，适合留下东西。
lines.en: By the river bend weeds, a good place to leave something.

lines.zh: 我们并排爬，黏液合成一条。
lines.en: We crawl side by side and our slime merges into one.

lines.zh: 不急，我们有一整天。
lines.en: No hurry; we have the whole day.

lines.zh: 这一片石头，以后会有很多小壳。
lines.en: These stones will hold many small shells soon.

lines.zh: 它蹭了蹭我的壳边，很轻。
lines.en: It brushes the rim of my shell, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片藻上停下来。
lines.en: We settle on the same patch of algae.

lines.zh: 慢有慢的好处，什么都看得清。
lines.en: Slow has its virtues; you see everything clearly.

lines.zh: 你把我捡起来了，我正在晃。
lines.en: You have picked me up and I am swaying.

lines.zh: 壳里听得见你的心跳。
lines.en: Inside my shell I can hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 别翻过来，我不想头朝下。
lines.en: Do not turn me over; I dislike hanging head down.

lines.zh: 我缩得很紧，你只能看见黑壳。
lines.en: I am pulled in tight; you see only black shell.

lines.zh: 你要带我去哪条河？
lines.en: Which river are you taking me to?

lines.zh: 冷风灌进壳口，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Cold air pours into my shell and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我的黏液沾了你一手。
lines.en: My slime is now all over your hand.

lines.zh: 放下来的时候，请轻一点。
lines.en: When you set me down, please be gentle.

lines.zh: 我在你掌心里转了个方向。
lines.en: I turn myself around in your palm.

lines.zh: 这比走路快太多了。
lines.en: This is far faster than walking.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落进水里，我看见了。
lines.en: A leaf falls into the water and I see it.

lines.zh: 那里有藻，颜色比别处深。
lines.en: There is algae there, darker than the rest.

lines.zh: 我把身体转向那个方向。
lines.en: I turn my body toward that direction.

lines.zh: 一片菜叶正慢慢沉下来。
lines.en: A cabbage leaf is slowly sinking.

lines.zh: 同伴没注意，我先看到。
lines.en: My companion missed it; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 那个绿点在动，是被水推的。
lines.en: That green speck moves, pushed by the water.

lines.zh: 目标不远，只隔着两块石头。
lines.en: The goal is near, just two stones away.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，看清楚了。
lines.en: I lift my front half and get a clear look.

lines.zh: 是吃的，我确定。
lines.en: It is food; I am certain.

lines.zh: 我开始挪，朝着它。
lines.en: I begin to creep, straight toward it.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片叶子，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I fix on the leaf and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 它沉得比我爬得快。
lines.en: It sinks faster than I can crawl.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，直线太窄。
lines.en: I go around the stone; the straight line is too narrow.

lines.zh: 同伴也想吃，我抢先一步。
lines.en: My companion wants it too, so I get there first.

lines.zh: 就差一点，我的触角碰到了。
lines.en: Almost there; my tentacle touches it.

lines.zh: 水一推，它又飘远半寸。
lines.en: The water pushes and it drifts half an inch away.

lines.zh: 我很有耐心，一直看着。
lines.en: I am patient and keep watching it.

lines.zh: 壳太沉，我快不起来。
lines.en: My shell is too heavy; I cannot speed up.

lines.zh: 它卡在石缝里了，正好。
lines.en: It caught in a stone crack — perfect.

lines.zh: 我张开口器，准备咬。
lines.en: I open my mouthparts and prepare to bite.

lines.zh: 我用齿舌刮它，一下一下。
lines.en: I scrape it with my radula, stroke by stroke.

lines.zh: 它想跑，可它没有我慢。
lines.en: It tries to flee, but nothing is as slow as me.

lines.zh: 咬住叶脉，我往下拖。
lines.en: I bite the leaf vein and drag it down.

lines.zh: 我被弹了一下，壳晃了晃。
lines.en: I am bounced back and my shell rocks.

lines.zh: 这点力气，只够咬破表皮。
lines.en: My strength only suffices to break the skin.

lines.zh: 我趴在它上面，慢慢磨。
lines.en: I lie on top of it and grind away slowly.

lines.zh: 它挣扎，我也没松口。
lines.en: It struggles, and I do not let go.

lines.zh: 同伴过来分一口，我让了。
lines.en: A companion comes for a share and I yield.

lines.zh: 牙不是牙，是一排小锉刀。
lines.en: My teeth are no teeth; they are a row of files.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我原地不动。
lines.en: Finished eating, and I do not move from here.

lines.zh: 我在河边出现，先闻了闻水。
lines.en: I appear by the river and sniff the water first.

lines.zh: 这里的水比我想的浅。
lines.en: This water is shallower than I expected.

lines.zh: 壳是新的，还带着点潮气。
lines.en: The shell is new and still a little damp.

lines.zh: 我找到一个阴暗的石缝，先住下。
lines.en: I find a shaded stone crack and settle in.

lines.zh: 附近只有一只同伴，正好。
lines.en: Only one companion nearby — just right.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬向最近的一片藻。
lines.en: I crawl slowly toward the nearest algae patch.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在这儿，我记得。
lines.en: Someone set me here, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 河水的声音让我安心。
lines.en: The sound of the river puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 黑帽上沾了第一粒沙。
lines.en: The first grain of sand sticks to my black cap.

lines.zh: 我打算在这里过很久。
lines.en: I intend to stay here a very long time.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得烫，我缩到最里面。
lines.en: The shell bakes hot and I shrink to its depths.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell lands first.

lines.zh: 我在水底，水却进了壳里。
lines.en: I am underwater, yet water gets inside my shell.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被掀到岸上。
lines.en: A blast throws me clear onto the bank.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进壳缝，很尖。
lines.en: Something sharp drives into a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进壳里，绕过了石头的硬。
lines.en: An odd force enters my shell, past all this hardness.

lines.zh: 饿久了，连壳的重量都忘了。
lines.en: Hunger lasts so long I forget the weight of my shell.

lines.zh: 雷声比雨先到，我壳里在响。
lines.en: Thunder comes before rain, ringing inside my shell.

lines.zh: 下面没有河底了，我在空中翻。
lines.en: The riverbed is gone and I tumble through air.
